text:
Maya: Quick sync: we need a readable emergency contract for EU tenant writes when EU primary is unreachable. Avoid silent cross-border writes.
Alex: Agreed. Default deny unless tenant opts in. Header hints planned.
Li: If we block all writes, ops gets paged and customers are unhappy. We need an operator-safe fallback.
Sanjay: Two-mode per-tenant: `strict_residency` -> 409 + structured error; `escrow_fallback` -> 202 + escrow id, EU-only storage.
Maya: UX: prefer 409 with code `residency.block` and help_url rather than 451.
Alex: Draft response shapes (as string): 409 -> error=residency.block, reason=tenant requires EU residency, help_url=https://redwood.example/residency; 202 -> status=escrowed, escrow_id=<uuid>, info=stored in EU escrow.
ops-bot: deploy:region-router v2.1 -> canary eu-west-1 :rocket:
Emily: Important infra constraint: any escrow must guarantee PII never leaves EU. EU-only KMS and access controls.
Li: Escrow design notes: EU S3-like store, per-tenant KMS key, minimal metadata (escrow_id, tenant, ts, op_hash), reconcile job runs only in EU.
Sanjay: Operator workflow: manual remit CLI `remit --escrow-id <id> --dst <region> --signoff <ticket>` which appends audit entry and triggers controlled transfer after legal signoff.
Maya: Runbook: preflight checks, TTL for escrow retention, auto-alert security if retention >2h, include `X-Fallback-Allowed` header for explicit client opt-in.
Vince: SDKs should surface the error code and help_url and handle 202/409 appropriately in UI flows.
Alex: Header contract to PR: `X-Residence: eu|us|asia` (optional), `X-Fallback-Mode: strict|escrow|auto` (server-controlled), response header `X-Escrow-ID` on 202, telemetry tag residency_status=blocked|escrowed|ok.
Emily: Cost/ops note: escrow is stateful. I'll estimate retention and KMS delta after Li posts infra doc.
Li: I'll upload the escrow infra doc and include reconciliation semantics and audit format.
Maya: Next steps: Alex PR for headers + errors, Li doc, Emily estimate, SRE add telemetry flags. Sync in 48h. Filing RFC tracker RFC-RESIDENCY-FOLLOWUP-327654. Closing thread.
